review.finding: Splicing a transient-rejected test card out of cards/testCards/awaitingTestResult in missionActivityFeedResolve.ts left it still reachable as a value in the pre-existing state.authoringConsumedBy map whenever the dropped card was also a TDD authoring run. A later, out-of-order rollback of its backing Write (rollbackFailedWrite/unstampAuthoringRun in missionActivityFeedAuthoringRollback.ts) could look the detached card up and misread its "neither failed nor pending" shape as a SUCCESSFUL recovery, wrongly clearing an unrelated, still-open genuine test failure's red status.
review.suggestion: Purge the matching authoringConsumedBy entry (and clear card.authoringRun) at splice time, so a later rollback behaves as if this run had never consumed the tracker slot.

review.finding: The AC3/AC4 work pushed missionActivityFeedResolve.ts from its already-at-ceiling 300 lines to 332+, violating the project's file-size convention.
review.suggestion: Split into cohesive files (the splice+purge helper, and the pre-existing untouched generic blocker branch) rather than trimming comments.
